definition: Collect Earth Online (CEO)-generated identifier for the sampled location.
values_or_format: One stable identifier per sampled location.
notes: Used with agriculturalyear to identify a point-year record.

definition: Starting calendar year of the August-July agricultural year.
notes: For example, 2001 represents August 2001 through July 2002.

definition: Human-readable label for the August-July agricultural year.
notes: Corresponds to agriculturalyear and the following calendar year.

definition: Original longitude of the sampled CEO location before any documented relocation.
notes: Geographic coordinate.

definition: Original latitude of the sampled CEO location before any documented relocation.
notes: Geographic coordinate.

definition: Final longitude used for the sampled location after documented relocation, where applicable.
notes: May equal originallongitude when no relocation occurred.

definition: Final latitude used for the sampled location after documented relocation, where applicable.
notes: May equal originallatitude when no relocation occurred.

definition: Indicates whether a revised coordinate was recorded for the sampled location.
notes: TRUE indicates that a relocation was recorded.

definition: Indicates that a possible point relocation was noted but had not been confirmed.
notes: A review flag; by itself it does not imply exclusion.

definition: Consolidated crop-system or crop-class entry associated with assigned interpreter slot 1 for the point-year.
notes: At most one consolidated response per assigned interpreter is used when constructing response tiers.

definition: Consolidated crop-system or crop-class entry associated with assigned interpreter slot 2 for the point-year.
notes: At most one consolidated response per assigned interpreter is used when constructing response tiers.

definition: Consolidated crop-system or crop-class entry associated with assigned interpreter slot 3 for the point-year.
notes: At most one consolidated response per assigned interpreter is used when constructing response tiers.

definition: Number of available consolidated responses associated with the assigned interpreter slots for the point-year.
notes: Used in constructing the recorded response tier.

definition: Recorded response-tier category assigned to the point-year after assignment-aware response consolidation.
values_or_format: Three-of-three crop agreement; Two-of-three crop majority; Two-of-two crop agreement; One crop class response; Crop system conflict; Two crop disagreement; Three way crop disagreement; Non-cropped only; Irrigated only; Conflicting non-crop systems; Repeated export conflict; No response
notes: Describes available final response configurations and is not a formal estimate of label accuracy or pre-adjudication agreement.

definition: Standardized crop type or crop-rotation class assigned where an eligible crop agreement or majority exists.
values_or_format: Soybean; Corn; Cotton; Sugarcane; Rice; Other; Soybean-corn; Soybean-cotton; Soybean-other; blank/not applicable
notes: Used for eligible crop-label records; unresolved or non-crop records may be blank.

definition: Broad analytical family corresponding to the standardized crop type or crop rotation.
values_or_format: Single crop; Single crop/perennial; Single crop/other; Double crop; other auxiliary/non-crop categories where applicable
notes: Used for class-family summaries in the manuscript.

definition: Available cover-crop response retained as an auxiliary attribute for the point-year.
notes: Not treated as a mutually exclusive crop class and not used as a blanket exclusion criterion.

definition: Quality-control status indicating whether the point-year was retained or explicitly excluded under the documented QC decisions.
notes: Excluded records remain in the complete audit dataset.

definition: Documented basis for quality-control exclusion, where applicable.
values_or_format: Free text or controlled reason, where applicable
notes: Examples described in the manuscript include location-level exclusion, year-specific exclusion, or unresolved EVI review. Normalized from the manuscript typo 'quexclusionreason'.

definition: Indicates that free-text interpretation notes identified the point-year for quality-control review.
notes: This flag alone does not imply exclusion.

definition: Indicates whether a complete group review or adjudication status was recorded for the sampled location.
notes: Documents completion of the review/adjudication process.

definition: Recorded review or adjudication disposition for the point-year or sampled location.
notes: Exact values should follow those present in the released dataset.

definition: Suggested analytical use of the point-year based on its response tier and quality-control status.
values_or_format: Examples: training candidate; audit only; auxiliary non-crop; auxiliary irrigated
notes: Provides a recommended use rather than an independent measure of label correctness.
